subject: Lumina Health pilot kickoff — operational playbook & access requests
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lumina Health pilot kickoff — operational playbook & access requests

Thanks again for the time today, Elena — good discussion. Below is a concise recap of what we aligned on, the proposed pilot scope, success metrics, owners, and the immediate access items we need to get the pilot started. Please confirm and add any corrections or missing stakeholders.

1) Key pain points you shared
- High latency and unpredictable token costs with current vendor for clinical note summarization.
- Need for consistent extraction accuracy for diagnoses and medication entities (F1 target > 0.88).
- Tight security/compliance requirements (PHI handling, audit logs).

2) Pilot goals (what success looks like)
- Latency: p95 < 250ms for API-invocation for 512-token summaries.
- Quality: extraction F1 >= 0.88 on the provided eval set; human-rated helpfulness >= 4/5.
- Cost: reduce per-note token cost by >= 30% vs current baseline.
- Operational: ability to run scheduled prompt-set evals and access request/audit logs.

3) Proposed pilot scope (3-5 weeks)
- Week 0: Access & onboarding (API keys, sample data upload, role assignments).
- Week 1: Baseline runs on supplied sample (500 redacted clinical notes).
- Week 2: Prompt tuning, quantization variant tests, KV-prefix caching enabled for repeated prompts.
- Week 3: Evaluation, regression checks, and quality sign-off (shared eval notebook).
- Week 4: Wrap, recommend next steps (Dedicated or Private deployment recommendation).

4) Owners
- Redwood: Marcus Lin (sales, engagement lead), Ava Chen (solutions engineering, pilot runbook & prompts), Diego Fernandez (customer success, onboarding & SLA).
- Lumina: Elena Novak (CDO) — primary, pending: Rick Morales (procurement) and security contact to be added.

5) Immediate asks from Lumina (what we need to proceed)
- Access: a technical contact + service account or API key request form for sample ingestion.
- Data: upload 500 redacted clinical notes (S3 link or secure share).
- Compliance: primary security contact and any existing vendor questionnaire (we attached our SOC2 summary).
- Network: confirm whether you'd prefer Hosted, Dedicated, or Private (VPC peering) pilot. Private requires additional lead time.

Attachments (in this email): poc-charter-lumina-v1.pdf, access-checklist.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Proposed kickoff: Mon Feb 16, 10:00am PT — tentative. If that doesn't work, suggest two alternatives.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Novak <elena.novak@luminahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rick Morales <rick.morales@luminahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Lumina Health pilot kickoff — operational playbook & access requests

Thanks Marcus — this is helpful. A few clarifying items and requests from our side:

- Procurement loop-in: looping Rick (procurement) to start paperwork — Rick, we'll need Redwood's standard MSA + BAA.
- PHI handling: we need confirmation that Redwood can support a pilot with deidentified data and agree to a short retention window (30 days) for pilot artifacts. Do you support configurable retention per-tenant?
- SOC2: we received your SOC2 summary but our security team will want the controls mapping and a contact. Can you provide a security contact?
- Timeline: we'd like to accelerate the Baseline (can we start baseline runs before a formal kickoff if the access artifact is provided this week?).

One more ask — our clinical team will provide a small preliminary eval set (n=100) by Friday for early tuning. Is that okay?

Also please add our privacy lead (maria.hamilton@luminahealth.com) to the thread — she will own the PHI question.

Appreciate it, Elena
Elena Novak
Chief Data Officer, Lumina Health

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Rick Morales <rick.morales@luminahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Lumina Health pilot kickoff — operational playbook & access requests

Great questions — quick answers and next steps:

- MSA + BAA: we'll send a draft MSA and a standard BAA to Rick today. We can do accelerated counters on the pilot contract (two-week turnaround typical).
- Retention: yes — Redwood supports per-tenant retention settings. For pilots we typically set 30-day retention by default; we can lock to 0-30 days based on your preference. We'll note this as a constraint in the charter.
- Security contact: looping Leah Ortiz (leah.ortiz@redwood.com), our security lead, who will follow up with the controls mapping and a short SOC2 controls-to-requirements spreadsheet.
- Early baseline runs: absolutely — if you can provide the preliminary eval set (n=100) and a secure upload link, Ava can run a quick baseline by EOD Friday. Please ensure PHI is deidentified per your privacy rules; if not, we will run on a redacted copy inside a Private pilot environment.

I'll attach the SOC2 summary and a short one-page pilot playbook (we've included them in the attachments). Next step: Rick/Procurement — please confirm the purchasing contact and whether a PO is required for the pilot.

—Marcus

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@luminahealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@redwood.com>, maria.hamilton@luminahealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Lumina Health — Pilot operational playbook (access checklist + kickoff)

Hi Elena / Maria / team — putting the operational details in one place so engineering on both sides can act quickly. I've scheduled the kickoff for Mon Feb 23, 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent). If you need an earlier time, let me know.

Access checklist (required prior to baseline runs)
- Create a Lumina service account or provide an S3 share with limited access (recommended: S3 + temporary credentials).
- Share sample eval set (n=100) in s3://lumina-pilot/incoming/ (please include README with field descriptions).
- Confirm desired retention window (default 30 days) and provide privacy contact (Maria copied).
- If choosing Private deployment: provide VPC CIDR and preferred region (us-west-2). Note: Private prep adds ~7 business days.
- Add our IPs for temporary whitelist (see access-checklist.xlsx attachment).

Pilot runbook highlights
- Baseline: Ava will run runs on the 100-sample set within 24 hours of access; deliverable: baseline metrics csv + short human review.
- Prompt set: we'll start with the extraction prompts we demoed; we'll version prompts in a shared Google doc (link in calendar invite).
- Evals: scheduled automated evals (nightly) and a cross-check human review at the end of Week 2.

Owners and SLAs for pilot tasks
- Onboarding (credentials & upload): Lumina technical contact
- Baseline runs & prompt updates: Ava Chen (Redwood) — ava.chen@redwood.com
- Cost & billing questions: Marcus Lin — marcus.lin@redwood.com
- Security & controls: Leah Ortiz (Redwood) & Maria Hamilton (Lumina)

Artifacts attached: access-checklist.xlsx, poc-charter-lumina-v1.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

If you can upload the initial 100-sample eval set and confirm the retention preference by Thurs Feb 19 EOD, Ava will complete an initial baseline on Friday Feb 20.

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
